title: European Debt Crisis: More Integration or Withering of a Dream?
description: This course explores the developments and events that led to the formation of the Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) and analyzes the causes for the eruption of the debt crisis. In addition, the course evaluates the policy steps taken to stabilize the crisis (monetary, banking, fiscal and institutional measures), and it discuss policy options to overcome in a lasting manner the design flaws and strengthen the governance of the EMU, so as to improve its overall economic growth performance.
